tagline: Planned: a history of a design that records what changed in engineering terms, not just in pixels.
description: EH3D-DESIGN-HISTORY is planned as a version-control layer with the semantic history and the logical evolution of the design. Today it has the base of every repository of the suite and a written scope, requirements and dependencies; no code has been written and nothing has been run on a machine.
